exposure: intraplacental fetal artery (IFA) characteristics (maximum diameter (D-max) and outer placental-half extension)
prenatal placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) ultrasonographic classification
cohort: The study included 62 women with placenta previa and at least one previous cesarean section, who were managed for placenta accreta spectrum.
finding: Outer placental-half extension of the intraplacental fetal artery (IFA) and an IFA D-max >3.5 mm were significantly associated with an increased risk of cesarean-hysterectomy, improving prenatal prediction of this need.
